IS 2720 (Part 16):1987 (Reaffirmed), IS 9669:1980, IS 919 8:1979. 1.2 Application Evaluating the strength of soil, subgrade, base, and sub-b ase materials used in highway and pavement engineering. SECTION 2: LOADING MACHINE (LOAD FRAME) 2.1 Type Rigid, motorized load frame (floor-standing type) with robu st and stable construction. 2.2 Maximum Load Capacity 50 kN (5,000 kgf) or higher. 2.3 Loading Rate Fixed, automatic strain-controlled rate of 1.25 mm/min (± 0.1 mm/min), as per IS: 2720 (Part 16). A three-speed gear box (e.g., 1.5, 1.25, & 2.5 mm/min) is desirable for versatility. 2.4 Controls & Safety • Emergency Stop Switch: Prominently placed on front pan el. • Over-travel Protection: Automatic motor stop at preset li mits to prevent damage to load cell, LVDT, and machine. • Digital Control Panel: Push-button/touch-keypad operatio n with LED/LCD display. SECTION 3: FORCE MEASUREMENT SYSTEM

3.1 Primary System (Load C 1 No. High-accuracy, S-type Load Cell, 50 kN capacity. Acc ells) uracy: ±1% of Full Scale or better. Display: Digital (resolut ion 0.001 kN or better) with zeroing, peak hold, and calibra tion functions. SECTION 4: PENETRATION MEASUREMENT SYSTEM 4.1 Primary System (LVDT) 1 No. High-accuracy Linear Variable Differential Transform er (LVDT) for piston penetration measurement. Range: Min imum 0–25 mm. Resolution: 0.01 mm or better. Mountable to the load frame using standard clamping arm or tripod. SECTION 5: DATA ACQUISITION SYSTEM (CONTROLLER) 5.1 Channel Capacity Controller and software must read from LVDT and Load Cel l channels simultaneously. Supports individual channel cali bration and data logging. 5.2 Data Acquisition PC software for real-time data logging and graphing, auto matically generating the load vs. penetration curve as per IS: 2720 (Part 16). SECTION 6: ACCESSORIES (AS PER IS: 9669 & IS: 2386) 6.1 CBR Mould Cylindrical, gunmetal or mild steel. Internal Diameter: 150 mm, Height: 175 mm. With detachable perforated base pla te. 6.2 Extension Collar Internal Diameter: 150 mm, Height: 50 mm (for compactio n). 6.3 Spacer Disc Diameter: 148 mm, Thickness: 47.7 mm, complete with ha ndle. 6.4 Surcharge Weights Set of annular and slotted surcharge weights (2.5 kg each) as per IS: 9669. 6.5 Penetration Piston Diameter: 50 mm, with adjustable stem for accurate cente ring. 6.6 Perforated Swell Plate Brass construction, with adjustable stem and lock nut (for swell measurement during soaking).

6.7 Tripod Stand Rigid, chrome-plated metal tripod for securely mounting m easurement devices during testing. 6.8 Filter Papers 20 sets of filter papers (top and bottom). 6.9 Compaction Rammers Light Compaction: 2.6 kg (310 mm drop); Heavy Compacti on: 4.89 kg (450 mm drop). 6.10 Length & Flakiness Gaug The bidder must supply 1 No. Length Gauge (Elongation G es auge) and 1 No. Flakiness Gauge with compulsory ISI certif ication marks, strictly conforming to IS: 2386 (Part I). SECTION 7: ANCILLARY EQUIPMENT & SERVICES 7.1 Soaking Tank Galvanized/stainless steel tank to submerge at least three CBR moulds, with perforated platform and water level indic ator. 7.2 Documentation & Certifi Product Catalogue, Compliance Certificates (IS/ASTM/BS), I cations SO/CE Declaration, OEM Authorization Letter, and Minimu m 3-Year Warranty with servicing center details. 7.3 Delivery & Training NIST/National standard traceable Calibration Certificates (l oad cell, LVDT), Operational & Maintenance Manuals, Deliv ery, Installation, Testing, and On-site Training for instructo rs. 3.
